==English==
{{wp}}

===Etymology===
{{ety|en|:af|testis<alt:test(is)>|-o-|-sterone<t:steroid hormone>|text=+|tree=1}}

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/tɛˈstɒ.stə.ɹəʊn/|a=RP}}
* {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Vealhurl-testosterone.wav|a=Southern England}}
* {{IPA|en|/tɛˈstɑ.stəˌɹoʊn/|a=GA}}
* {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Naomi Persephone Amethyst (NaomiAmethyst)-testosterone.wav|a=GA}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun|~}}

# {{lb|en|steroid hormone}} A {{w|steroid hormone}} that stimulates [[development]] of [[male]] {{w|secondary sexual characteristic}}s, produced mainly in the [[testis|testes]], but also in the [[ovary|ovaries]] and [[adrenal cortex]].
#* {{quote-journal|en|author=Mark Hay|title=Does '''Testosterone''' Affect Your Politics?|magazine={{w|Vice (magazine)|VICE}}|url=https://www.vice.com/en/article/testosterone-hormone-politics-research/|date=2023-04-05|passage=The text recounts a 2011 experiment: Researchers tested 136 healthy young men’s '''testosterone''' levels, asked them about their political party affiliations, then gave them either a placebo or ten grams of AndroGel one percent, a high-end dose of a common form of '''testosterone''' often used in hormone replacement therapies.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20260904172835/https://www.vice.com/en/article/testosterone-hormone-politics-research/|archivedate=4 September 2026}}
# {{lb|en|figuratively}} {{U|manly}} behavior, often of an [[aggressive]] or foolishly [[reckless]] nature.
#: {{ux|en|Mother encouraged James to rely more on intelligence and less on '''testosterone''' to deal with the neighbor's son.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2023|author=w:Louise Casey, Baroness Casey of Blackstock|title=Baroness Casey Review Final Report: An independent review into the standards of behaviour and internal culture of the Metropolitan Police Service|chapter=9.2.5|url=https://www.met.police.uk/SysSiteAssets/media/downloads/met/about-us/baroness-casey-review/update-march-2023/baroness-casey-review-march-2023a.pdf|page=268|text=The {{w|Metropolitan Police|MPS}} is a male orientated and [[misogynistic]] environment filled with '''testosterone''', [[notch on one's bedpost|notches on bed posts]] and [[conquest]]s.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20260924074116/https://www.met.police.uk/SysSiteAssets/media/downloads/met/about-us/baroness-casey-review/update-march-2023/baroness-casey-review-march-2023a.pdf|archivedate=24 September 2026}}
